_comment: Roles that the people and systems of the pilgrim's journey (user-scenarios/) play, named after this guide's personas and system actors (input/pagecontent/personas.md, system-actors.md). Schema: cat-harness-tools/schemas/process/role-graph.ts. Every person is fictional.
name: smart-ips-pilgrimage

roles.title: Pilgrim
roles.description: The person performing Hajj who holds the health wallet and decides who may see their patient summary.

roles.title: Accompanying family member
roles.description: A relative travelling with the pilgrim who speaks for them when they cannot. Not yet a persona of this guide.

roles.title: Counsellor
roles.description: The empanelled clinician at home who does the pre-Hajj health examination and counsels the pilgrim on consent and the wallet.

roles.title: Accompanying clinician from origin country
roles.description: A doctor of the home country's Hajj medical team, travelling with the pilgrims.
otherNames: Accompanying Clinician from Origin Country (IG persona)

roles.title: Host country health worker
roles.description: A nurse or doctor at a health facility in the host country who registers and treats the pilgrim.

roles.title: Origin country wallet
roles.description: The pilgrim's national health wallet: records consent, holds the VHL QR code and shows it.
otherNames: Origin Country Wallet (IG system actor OCHW)

roles.title: Origin country HIE
roles.description: The home country's health information exchange: assembles and signs the IPS, issues the VHL and answers the host's requests for it.
otherNames: Origin Country HIE (IG system actor OCHIE)

roles.title: Host country EMR
roles.description: The host facility's electronic medical record: scans the QR code, verifies the signature, retrieves the IPS and keeps a rendered copy.
otherNames: Host Country EMR (IG system actor HCEMR)

roles.title: Trust network
roles.description: WHO GDHCN: the trust network both countries take part in, which distributes the public keys documents are signed with.
